summary: Kaniksu lookout near Sandpoint: camp 1921, cupola cabin 1922, lookouts named in 1927-1931 papers; cabin since removed, date unknown.

facts.status_note: Cabin since removed; removal date not given

staffing.status: Clarence Sperling named as lookout in 1927; Charles Stidwell named in 1929 and 1931 in newspaper items; no complete staffing history found

events.note: Clarence Sperling named as the lookout in a Pend Oreille Review report of a lightning storm; earliest named lookout in the sources read
Charles Stidwell reported leaving for the station for the summer (June 1929, two papers)
Charles Stidwell reported as having been stationed on Mt. Baldy (August 1931)

evidence.supports: camp in 1921; cupola cabin built in 1922; cabin since removed
evidence.quote: Established with a camp in 1921, this cupola cabin, built in 1922, has since been removed.

notes_for_editor: The 1929 and 1931 newspaper items call the station Bald mountain or Mt. Baldy. The story takes them to mean this lookout because Forest Lookouts files them under Sandpoint Baldy; no newspaper names Sandpoint Baldy itself. The removal date is not given in any source; firelookout.com's R.I.P. 1922-? is blank at the end. No source read describes the site today or whether it is reachable. Staffing is partial: only these three named lookouts appear in the sources read.
